additional-text.description: Audio Text: Construction work on I-65 south of State Road 2 in both northbound and southbound directions will be ongoing from August 2nd through mid-October to patch and resurface asphalt pavement. This work consists of 4 phases anticipated to take two weeks each to complete. During the first phase, the inside lane and shoulder of southbound I-65 will be closed at night from approximately 8 PM to 6 AM, reducing the maximum width to 14 feet. Southbound I-65 will be patched and resurfaced from Mile Marker 237.8 to Mile Marker 240, and pavement markings and RPM’s will be replaced up to the Lowell Weigh Station at Mile Marker 241. Drainage improvement work will also be conducted along the shoulders and median during the daytime hours. Shoulders will be closed, but a minimum of 2 travel lanes will remain open in both directions. A temporary speed reduction to 55 mph will be in effect for the duration of this project. Please use caution when approaching this location. Expect delays, and stay alert for construction vehicles entering and exiting the work site.

Web Text: Construction work on I-65 south of SR 2 in both northbound and southbound directions will be ongoing from August 2nd through mid-October to patch and resurface asphalt pavement. This work consists of 4 phases anticipated to take two weeks each to complete. During the first phase, the inside lane and shoulder of southbound I-65 will be closed at night from approximately 8 PM to 6 AM, reducing the maximum width to 14 feet. Southbound I-65 will be patched and resurfaced from Mile Marker 237.8 to Mile Marker 240, and pavement markings and RPM’s will be replaced up to the Lowell Weigh Station at Mile Marker 241. Drainage improvement work will also be conducted along the shoulders and median during the daytime hours. Shoulders will be closed, but a minimum of 2 travel lanes will remain open in both directions.
A temporary speed reduction to 55 mph will be in effect for the duration of this project. Please use caution when approaching this location. Expect delays, and stay alert for construction vehicles entering and exiting the work site. To report a concern, call INDOT Customer Service: 1-855-463-6848.

Audio Text: This notice pertains to Phase 2 of the construction of a J‑Turn intersection at the junction of US‑41 and 151st Ave. Access to US‑41 from 151st Ave is now available. Westbound traffic on 151st Ave east of US‑41 may proceed northbound on US‑41, and eastbound traffic on 151st Ave west of US‑41 may proceed southbound on US‑41. Access from US‑41 to 151st Ave is limited. Northbound traffic on US‑41 may access eastbound 151st Ave only, while southbound traffic on US‑41 may access westbound 151st Ave only. During this phase, motorists should be alert for construction vehicles entering and exiting the work zone, as well as watering crews periodically operating at reduced speeds within the traffic lanes to maintain newly placed sod and seed in the adjacent ditch areas. Narrow‑lane conditions will be in effect for both northbound and southbound traffic. Additional updates will be provided as the project progresses.

I wanted to let you know that since yesterday, I've logged over 15 entries in CAR. However, I haven't received a single notification, even though I checked the box at the top and included the group everyone was added to. Additionally, when Von submitted his entries, I didn't receive any notifications, and he didn't receive mine either.
Just as a heads-up, August is going to be a very active month for us—we have a major traffic switch coming up that will span the entire month. Between what Von and I have already entered and what we will be submitting throughout the month, we will easily have over 30 entries total.
Could you please help look into why the notifications aren't coming through?
Thanks so much,
GARY PERSINGER 317-519-7872

additional-text.description:
Web Text: Starting June 16, 2026 Rieth-Riley will start milling and resurface of the bus Lane from Franklin Road to Washington Square Mall entrance. They plan to start at Franklin Road in the eastbound lane and go east. Then turn at Washington Square Mall entrance and head back west in the west bound lane. They will take the inside lane during the day time hours and open it once paving operation is done for the day. To complete both lanes will take approximately two weeks. Starting June 30, 2026 Martell will start placing detector housing and detector loops for left turn lanes in both the east and west bound lanes from Franklin Road to German Church Road. They plan to start at Franklin Road in the eastbound lane and go east. Then turn at German Church and head back west in the west bound lane. They will take the inside lane during the day time hours and open it once loop detection operation is done for the day. To complete both lanes will take approximately three weeks.
Gradex is constructing new medians for the Indygo Blue Line from I465 to German Church. This work includes realigning intersection at road crossings, commercial driveways, and adding new shelters for bus passengers. When they complete this work it will take one lane away in each direction for a dedicated bus lane from I465 to German Church Road.
